min_distinct_paths.description: Distinct suspicious PHP paths needed. Default 6.

score_threshold.description: Score needed (see README for weights). Default 12.

legit_paths.description: Legitimate PHP paths; replaces the WordPress defaults. '/dir/' = segment anywhere, '/x.php' = exact path, 'x.php' = basename outside /wp-content/.

extra_legit_paths.description: Appended to legit_paths (or to the defaults).

ignore_user_agents.description: Case-insensitive UA substrings never counted; replaces the crawler defaults.

extra_ignore_user_agents.description: Appended to ignore_user_agents (or to the defaults).

ignore_vhosts.description: Vhosts never counted (e.g. a legacy non-WordPress PHP site).

shared_path_min_ips.description: Bonus +1 when that many other IPs probed the same path in the window; 0 = off. Default 3.
